Application for Financial Aid
The deadline for applying for most forms of financial assistance is March 15. Some programs, however, may have earlier deadlines. The school does not act on applications for aid until a student has been admitted.
While nonimmigrant visa holders are ineligible for federal and state financial aid, such applicants may qualify for assistantships and certain fellowships. See the Financial Aid chapter and the website https://scarlethub.rutgers.edu/financial-services/information-for/graduate-professional-students/ for further information.
For additional information, contact RU-info at 848-445-info (4636) .
